column1: # Hand-curated per-component MK spectral types — literature-based picks for
# WDS components that neither SIMBAD's per-component cross-IDs nor
# AT-HYG carry. SIMBAD enumerates Algol's WDS components as A/F/G only,
# so its per-component sp_type join can never supply Aa2's K0IV; the
# AT-HYG fallback inherits the system primary's type. Stage 6 reads
# this file as the top tier of the spectral cascade
#   component   — component designator EXACTLY as emitted in the
#                 multiples.tsv comp column, i.e. the raw WDS pair-cell
#                 form. WDS truncates repeated stems: Algol's Aa1,2 pair
#                 emits its secondary as comp="2" (canonical Aa2).
#   source      — literature reference for the classification.

column4: Algol Aa2 — Kolbas 2015 (/data/papers/index.md#kolbas2015) (early-K subgiant, Teff 4900 K; K0IV is a representative type)
delta Vel Ab — Mérand 2011 (/data/papers/index.md#merand2011) (two early A-type main-sequence stars, Ab mean Teff 9830 K; no MK subtype given, A4V is uncited)
sigma Ori Ab — Simón-Díaz 2011 (/data/papers/index.md#simondiaz2011) (Aa=O9.5V, Ab=B0.5V); Teff(Ab) 31 kK in Simón-Díaz 2015 (/data/papers/index.md#simondiaz2015)
Castor Ab — Stelzer 2003 (/data/papers/index.md#stelzer2003) (late-K companion, P=9.21 d; K7Ve is a representative subtype)
Castor Bb — Stelzer 2003 (/data/papers/index.md#stelzer2003) (early-M companion, P=2.93 d; M1Ve is a representative subtype)

Castor Ca (YY Gem A) — Torres 2002 (/data/papers/index.md#torres2002) (eclipsing twin; the paper gives M1.0 Ve and formal M_A 0.5975 M_sun, adopted mean 0.5992 — M0.5Ve is not its type, an open decision)

Castor Cb (YY Gem B) — Torres 2002 (/data/papers/index.md#torres2002) (eclipsing twin; the paper gives M1.0 Ve and formal M_B 0.6009 M_sun, adopted mean 0.5992 — M0.5Ve is not its type, an open decision)
Rigel Ba — Sanford 1942 (/data/papers/index.md#sanford1942) SB orbit, both components class B9; the V class is MSC catalogue data (data/msc/: B side V=7.6, B9V)
Rigel Bb — Sanford 1942 (/data/papers/index.md#sanford1942) SB orbit, both components class B9; MSC catalogue data (data/msc/) give masses 2.94+2.11 M_sun, both late-B dwarfs
